title: Outlook: share proposed meeting times in an email, with one-click booking for one-on-one meetings
summary: The roadmap details and the reported documentation gaps check out. However, the page assures administrators that nothing needs configuring before January even though Microsoft has not published the feature's default or enablement requirements; that assurance must be removed.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: No source states that existing Outlook behaviour will be replaced or changed by this feature.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: Nothing has to be configured before January.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook "Share Availability" "580444" default prerequisites license billing external authentication confirmation. Read roadmap, overview and policy-management page; none establishes that administrators will have no configuration requirement before rollout.
claims.fix: Remove 'and nothing has to be configured before January'. Use: 'No source says existing behaviour changes; the decision for now is whether the absence of a documented switch matters for your organisation.' The absence of published enablement requirements does not establish that no configuration will be needed.
